_comment: data/params/rsi_pullback/afks/plateau_base_both.json — BASELINE both: дефолты ядра + якорь zone при UseZoneEntry 1 (оба входа, при совпадении входит pullback). Единая калибровка rsi_pullback AFKS (/pullback-calibrate, спека docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-rsi-pullback-unified-calibration-design.md §4.1). История кэша с 2021-09-30 (60 мес) — основная схема 36/12/6, контрольная 36/18/6, окно -months 36. Выходы — дефолты ядра. ЗАПУСК (строго последовательно): полное окно — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker AFKS -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/afks/plateau_base_both.json -out ./reports/AFKS/base_both_full -months 36 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; walk-forward основной 36/12/6 — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker AFKS -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/afks/plateau_base_both.json -out ./reports/AFKS/base_both_wf1206 -months 36 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; контрольный 36/18/6 — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker AFKS -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/afks/plateau_base_both.json -out ./reports/AFKS/base_both_wf1806 -months 36 -train-months 18 -test-months 6 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; удвоенные издержки — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker AFKS -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/afks/plateau_base_both.json -out ./reports/AFKS/base_both_c001 -months 36 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -min-trades 1 -commission 0.001 -metric profit_factor.
